description: NaAl(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.75 Å. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-46°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.83 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.92 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Mo and one Al atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Al atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Al atom.
